user_questions.question: Should each tip be recorded against the specific order it was given on (orders live in the external Pronto Orders API, so we would store the order number on the tip), or is driver + date + amount enough? Options: (a) tie each tip to an order number and a driver [recommended]; (b) standalone tip with driver, date, and amount only.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Tips on orders attributed to drivers; weekly report. (mapped to option a)

skill_friction: Driver identity (Contact record type vs User vs ServiceResource vs new object) is both 'data structure' (decide) and 'which persona' (ask); SKILL.md step 5 does not say which bucket a missing core entity falls into. I decided it.

Who writes tips (app integration vs staff) is an intent/channel question, but predicting 'no preference' pushed it to a decision; it ends up as a blocking-for-delivery open item, which feels like it should have been asked.
Retry of a split I call: the table lists one kind 'retry' but a split sends two calls; unclear whether both halves are recorded as separate 'retry' entries (I did).
Report folder sharing: design rules do not cover who a new shared report folder is shared with; AskCoworker proposed an unsupported target (permission set holders).
Allow Reports object setting is unreadable yet load-bearing for the only reporting row; the skill says 'record as assumption' but does not say whether the dependent Report row should be Conditional.
